## Scope

The `src/app/features` folder holds three lazy-loaded feature areas: **article** (feeds, editor, detail, comments, favorites), **profile** (public profile, authored and favorited lists, follow), and **settings** (current-user form and logout). Each area uses `HttpClient` against Conduit REST paths defined in [CONTRACTS.md](../../../CONTRACTS.md). Domain terms live in [DOMAIN.md](../../../DOMAIN.md). Parent routing and app-wide conventions are in [src/app/AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md); auth and interceptors are in [src/app/core/AGENTS.md](../core/AGENTS.md).

## Components

| Component | Path | Responsibility |
|-----------|------|----------------|
| article | `article/` | Article list, preview, meta, favorites, comments; `ArticlesService`, `CommentsService`, `TagsService`; models and editor/detail pages (routes wired from app shell). |
| profile | `profile/` | `ProfileService`, follow UI, `profile.routes.ts` at `/profile/:username` with child routes for articles and favorites. |
| settings | `settings/` | `SettingsComponent` (`app-settings-page`); `PUT /user` via `UserService`; form fields `image`, `username`, `bio`, `email`, `password`. |

## Read first

| Area | Source files |
|------|----------------|
| article | `article/services/articles.service.ts`, `article/services/comments.service.ts`, `article/models/article.model.ts`, `article/components/article-list.component.ts` |
| profile | `profile/profile.routes.ts`, `profile/services/profile.service.ts`, `profile/models/profile.model.ts` |
| settings | `settings/settings.component.ts`, `settings/settings.component.html` |
| Cross-feature | `article/models/article.model.ts` and `comment.model.ts` import `Profile` from `profile/models/profile.model.ts` |

### Routes (RealWorld E2E alignment)

| Route pattern | Feature | Notes |
|---------------|---------|--------|
| `/` (home, Global Feed, Your Feed, tag feeds) | article | `ArticleListConfig` and `ArticlesService.query`; `.article-preview` pagination per [navigation.spec.ts](../../../realworld/specs/e2e/navigation.spec.ts). |
| `/editor`, `/editor/:slug` | article | Create and edit; publish navigates to `/article/:slug` (E2E helpers in `realworld/specs/e2e/helpers/articles.ts`). |
| `/article/:slug` | article | Detail, comments, author actions; UI contract in [CONTRACTS.md](../../../CONTRACTS.md). |
| `/profile/:username` | profile | `ProfileComponent`; default child `profile-articles.component` (`author` filter). |
| `/profile/:username/favorites` | profile | `profile-favorites.component`; `favorited` filter on article list. |
| `/settings` | settings | Successful `submitForm()` navigates to `/profile/:username` in `settings.component.ts`. |
| `/tag/:tag` | article | Tag-filtered lists; covered in [navigation.spec.ts](../../../realworld/specs/e2e/navigation.spec.ts). |

### HTTP surfaces (feature-owned)

| Service | Paths |
|---------|--------|
| `ArticlesService` | `GET/POST /articles`, `GET /articles/feed`, `GET/PUT/DELETE /articles/:slug`, favorite endpoints |
| `CommentsService` | `GET/POST /articles/:slug/comments`, `DELETE .../comments/:id` |
| `TagsService` | `GET /tags` |
| `ProfileService` | `GET /profiles/:username`, `POST/DELETE /profiles/:username/follow` |
| settings (via core) | `PUT /user` through `UserService` in `core/auth` |

### UI contract (E2E selectors)

Shared DOM expectations for these features are in [CONTRACTS.md](../../../CONTRACTS.md) and `realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md`. Examples tied to this folder: `.article-preview`, `.tag-pill`, `button:has-text("Publish Article")`, `app-settings-page` / settings form `name` attributes (`image`, `username`, `bio`, `email`, `password`), profile author links to `/profile/:username`, and `defaultImage` / `DefaultImagePipe` for null `image` on previews and comments.

## Check a change

| Change type | Verification | Status |
|-------------|--------------|--------|
| article UI or `ArticlesService` / comments | `bun run test:e2e -- realworld/specs/e2e/articles.spec.ts` | documented |
| feeds, tags, pagination, profile links from home | `bun run test:e2e -- realworld/specs/e2e/navigation.spec.ts` | documented |
| settings or null image/bio | `bun run test:e2e -- realworld/specs/e2e/settings.spec.ts`; add `null-fields.spec.ts` when applicable | documented |
| profile follow, favorited tab, social feeds | `bun run test:e2e -- realworld/specs/e2e/social.spec.ts` | documented |
| isolated TS logic | `bun run test` per [TESTING.md](../../../TESTING.md) | documented |
